mapper.sql: SELECT c.*,f.factory_name FROM metal_customer c JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=c.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE c.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: AND c.factory_id=#{factoryId} ORDER BY c.customer_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_customer SET customer_name=#{name},company_name=#{companyName},address=#{address},contact_name=#{contactName},contact_phone=#{contactPhone},department=#{department},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE customer_id=#{id} AND factory_id=#{factoryId} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT id FROM metal_production_order WHERE factory_id=#{factoryId} AND customer_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status IN ('CREATED','IN_PROGRESS') LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT work_order_id FROM metal_work_order WHERE factory_id=#{factoryId} AND customer_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0' AND status<>'COMPLETED' LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT stock_id FROM metal_storage_ownership WHERE factory_id=#{factoryId} AND owner_id=#{id} AND (weight>0 OR quantity>0) LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT id FROM metal_storage_debt WHERE factory_id=#{factoryId} AND (creditor_id=#{id} OR debtor_id=#{id}) AND (remaining_weight>0 OR remaining_quantity>0) LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT id FROM metal_storage_document WHERE factory_id=#{factoryId} AND deleted=0 AND status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','RETURNED') AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.customerId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{id} LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT l.id FROM metal_storage_document_line l JOIN metal_storage_document d ON d.id=l.document_id AND d.factory_id=l.factory_id WHERE d.factory_id=#{factoryId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','RETURNED') AND (CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.data,'$.ownerId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{id} OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.data,'$.ownerCustomerId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{id} OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.data,'$.customerId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{id} OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.data,'$.borrowOwnerId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{id} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(l.data,'$.allocations[*]' COLUMNS(owner_id LONGTEXT PATH '$.ownerId' NULL ON ERROR)) a WHERE CAST(a.owner_id AS UNSIGNED)=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT debt.id FROM JSON_TABLE(l.data,'$.debtAllocations[*]' COLUMNS(debt_id LONGTEXT PATH '$.debtId' NULL ON ERROR)) a JOIN metal_storage_debt debt ON debt.id=CAST(a.debt_id AS UNSIGNED) AND debt.factory_id=d.factory_id WHERE debt.creditor_id=#{id} OR debt.debtor_id=#{id})) LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT inventory_id FROM metal_inventory WHERE factory_id=#{factoryId} AND customer_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0' AND (net_weight>0 OR quantity>0) LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT c.closeout_id FROM metal_customer_residual_closeout c WHERE c.factory_id=#{factoryId} AND c.customer_id=#{id} AND c.status IN ('WAITING','PARTIAL') LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE) OR EXISTS(SELECT r.residual_id FROM metal_work_order_residual r JOIN metal_work_order w ON w.work_order_id=r.work_order_id WHERE w.factory_id=#{factoryId} AND r.customer_id=#{id} AND r.remaining_weight>0 AND r.status='OPEN' LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE)
